empty.heading: Your portrait is not here yet
empty.body: This page will describe you, drawn from the days you log and the journal you write. Until that exists, it stays empty rather than guess.

daily.label: Today's question
daily.unanswered: One question a day. Pick the answer closest to you.
daily.whyLabel: Why? (optional, only you can read this)
daily.whyPlaceholder: A line to remember it by
daily.changeNote: You can change your answer until midnight.

results.heading: How everyone answered
results.waiting: Results appear when 10 people have answered.
results.offline: Connect to the internet to see how everyone answered. Your answer is saved.
results.pending: Your answer is still being saved. Try again in a moment.
results.failed: The results could not be loaded.

crowd.label: Count my answers in the crowd results
crowd.hint: Only as a number. Never with your name, your note or the date.

choices.heading: Your choices
choices.intro: Which way your daily answers lean, beside what the test said. This is kept apart from the test and never changes it.
choices.trackAria: {{trait}}: your choices at {{choices}} out of 100, your test at {{test}} out of 100.

drift.higher: Your choices lean toward “{{word}}” more than your test said.
drift.lower: Your choices lean toward “{{word}}” more than your test said.

choices.note: The line marks your test, the dot your choices. They appear after 10 answers on a trait.
